Halyard

A single page, written as one box, the way a hand-built site often is.

Get started

Everything below the heading sits in the same box as the heading, so no boundary in the markup separates one part of the page from another.

A schema that named this section would be naming the page. The honest answer is that it did not resolve, and the element list is what a rebuild has to work from.

The heading is large and near the top, which is exactly the shape a hero has. That is what makes the guard worth having: the shape alone is not enough when the box is everything.
